# `<convert.h>`

```c
#include <convert.h>
```

| Name | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="ntohs"></a>`ntohs` | `htons` | Network to host order, 16-bit; the same swap as htons(). |

## Functions

### `atoh` { #atoh }

```c
int atoh(const char *str);
```

Convert a hexadecimal string to an integer.

Skips leading whitespace, accepts a sign, and stops at the first non-hex character. No "0x" prefix and no overflow check.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `str` | in | Pointer to the null-terminated hexadecimal string. |

**Returns:** The converted integer value.

### `atoi` { #atoi }

```c
int atoi(const char *str);
```

Convert a decimal string to an integer.

Skips leading whitespace, accepts a sign, and stops at the first non-digit. No overflow check.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `str` | in | Pointer to the null-terminated string. |

**Returns:** The converted integer value.

### `itoa` { #itoa }

```c
char * itoa(int value, char *str, unsigned int base);
```

Convert a signed integer to a string.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | in | Integer value to convert. |
| `str` | out | Pointer to the buffer where the resulting string will be stored. |
| `base` | in | Numerical base, 2 to 36; digits above 9 are lowercase. |

**Returns:** Pointer to the resulting string. The caller MUST ensure the buffer is large enough.

### `utoa` { #utoa }

```c
char * utoa(unsigned int value, char *str, unsigned int base);
```

Convert an unsigned integer to a string.

| Parameter | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | in | Unsigned integer value to convert. |
| `str` | out | Pointer to the buffer where the resulting string will be stored. |
| `base` | in | Numerical base, 2 to 36; digits above 9 are lowercase. |

**Returns:** Pointer to the resulting string. The caller MUST ensure the buffer is large enough.
